Package org.geysermc.paletter

Class Fallbacks

java.lang.Object
org.geysermc.paletter.Fallbacks
public final class Fallbacks extends Object
What content a version lacks becomes: the one fallback policy of a Paletter. Entries apply to every version, or to one data version only (those win). Content without an entry uses the default.

Paletter bundles no replacements: UNKNOWN maps everything a version lacks to minecraft:unknown, NONE sends air and leaves items out. Consumers add better replacements with builder().

Since:
1.0.0
